svg.title: The Releases page
svg.desc: Every day, and with every change of main, the Docs workflow builds this website. Its hooks ask the API of GitHub once for the releases of every project with their notes, leave out drafts and prereleases, and keep of the notes only text, lists, headings, tables, code and links to https. They write the latest five releases of every project into the Releases page, and the latest release of every project with the headline of its notes into What's new on the home pages. Without the API, the page links the releases of every project on GitHub, and the build passes. As a page loads in a reader's browser, docs/javascripts/projects.js reads repos.json of the dashboard, adds a release that came out after the build with a link to its notes on GitHub, and tells the day of every release as the time since.
